answer: Resist history forgery with external anchoring. Each epoch the state root crosses a bridge to Solana and Base, anchored there as a checkpoint; anyone re-verifies the local ledger against those immutable anchors with one signature check. An attacker forging a paying history must rewrite it on two independent external chains - astronomically expensive. Each checkpoint is a jade seal on the record: the timber of past blocks may be reshuffled locally, but any branch disagreeing with the anchored roots is provably dead wood, so sybils cannot mint themselves a past.
